touches.body:
Hello Helge,

We at LocalOS help local businesses find relevant creators for partnerships. We noticed that you offer both influencer placements and UGC formats from Tallinn. We are mapping current creator terms so we only bring suitable briefs.

Could you share your current packages, rates, audience geography, recent sponsored reach, and preferred contact?

If a business matches, we will return with a specific brief; timing, disclosure, and usage rights will be agreed separately.
